testCases.title: AN — Client-Side Luhn Validation: Invalid Card Number Rejected
testCases.failedAssertion: [STATE] 'Place order' button enabled with Luhn-invalid card 1234567890123456 (all other fields filled); no inline error on card number field after blur; clicking Place Order created order c92e2e8f-9a15-4353-a8c7-3706c6d1e08b and redirected to /checkout/payment instead of blocking on /cart
testCases.notes: Accept.js (jstest.authorize.net) did NOT perform client-side Luhn validation before enabling Place Order or before allowing createOrderFromCart. Luhn-invalid card 1234567890123456 with valid expiry 12/29, CVV 123, and cardholder name: Place Order button became enabled; clicking it fired GA4 place_order event, created order c92e2e8f-9a15-4353-a8c7-3706c6d1e08b, and redirected to /checkout/payment (fallback path). No api2.authorize.net POST (tokenization blocked by AN library), but order was created before tokenization could succeed. GA4 sequence: begin_checkout → add_payment_info(AuthorizeNetPaymentMethod) → place_order — no purchase event (correct). Expected: Place Order stays disabled or shows inline error while Luhn-invalid card is present. Actual: Button enabled, order created, redirect to /checkout/payment.

Successful charge: order CO260615-00003 created at /checkout/completed. Card 4007000000027, expiry 12/29, CVV 900. Cart cleared after order. Order link: /account/orders/00171556-ad68-4e15-ad0f-38e0cc52598a.

testCases.title: AN — CDN Block Graceful Degradation
testCases.notes: CDN block simulation requires network route interception (page.route()) which is a programmatic bypass, not a real-user action. Playwright MCP browser tooling cannot block specific script CDN URLs via real-user interaction. Infrastructure-limited BLOCKED.

GA4 purchase event verified: exactly 1 'purchase' event in dataLayer with transaction_id=29bf146f-3bf0-478d-ac8d-c619a1a78e1f, currency=USD, value=200, items[0].item_id=ALCE0128. Event sequence: begin_checkout → add_shipping_info → add_payment_info(AuthorizeNetPaymentMethod) → place_order → purchase. Order CO260615-00004 created. No duplicate purchase events.
Navigating to /checkout/review redirected immediately to /cart — confirms AllowCartPayment=true cart-embedded flow is active, no multistep review page exists. By design per VCST-5162.

Per-field negative validation + recovery: expired date → 'Expiration date must be in the future'; month 13 → 'Provide a valid expiration month'; CVV 2-digit → 'Security code must be at least 3 characters'; non-numeric CVV 'abc' → silently filtered (field empty) → 'This field is required'; recovery (all valid) → no errors, Place Order enabled.

BVA expiry year: 1-digit '12/3' → 'Year must be exactly 2 characters', disabled; 2-digit expired '12/20' → 'Expiration date must be in the future', disabled; 2-digit future '12/29' → no error, Place Order enabled.

bugs.title: AN Accept.js: No client-side Luhn validation — invalid card enables Place Order and creates order
bugs.failedAssertion: [STATE] Place order button remains disabled with Luhn-invalid card
bugs.stepsToReproduce:
1. Login as agent slot 3, add item to cart
2. Select 'Bank card (Authorize.Net)' payment method
3. Fill card number with Luhn-invalid '1234 5678 9012 3456', expiry '12/29', CVV '123', cardholder 'John Smith'
4. Observe Place Order button state — ENABLED (expected: disabled or showing Luhn error)
5. Click Place Order — order is created (GA4 place_order event fired with transaction_id c92e2e8f-...), page redirects to /checkout/payment
bugs.expected: Place Order button remains disabled while a Luhn-invalid card number is entered, OR an inline error appears on the card number field after blur. Accept.js should reject the card client-side before any order is created.
bugs.actual: Place Order button becomes enabled after filling Luhn-invalid card number plus all other fields. Clicking Place Order calls createOrderFromCart (order created), fires GA4 place_order event, and redirects user to /checkout/payment as a fallback (since Accept.js tokenization returns error for invalid card). No inline Luhn error shown. No api2.authorize.net POST (tokenization not sent), but order already exists in platform.
